span.p:
WORKFLOW_STATUSES = idle, planning, delegating,
validating, compiling, completed, failed.
set_workflow_status does not enforce a transition
table. The offline manager only writes planning,
completed and failed. Turn result is derived:
failed if workflow or a specialist failed,
needs_input if open questions exist, else success.
